capabilities: insert inline icon shortcodes (::icon-id::) into note text and properties
attach icons to files and folders in the sidebar
style icon categories globally via custom CSS targets
bundle SVG definitions locally for offline icon rendering
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; it can be installed via BRAT as a beta plugin, and troubleshooting covers themes that do not support dynamic SVG rendering.
motivation: Developed as a companion plugin for the Project Mantle ecosystem to integrate icons into the workspace structure.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to add visual icons to notes, properties, or the file sidebar for faster visual navigation.

relations.evidence: Mantle Icons is designed to pair with the Zenith theme, matching its accent colors, drop shadows
Method B: Via BRAT (Beta Reviewer's Auto-update Tester)

summary: Icon plugin that inserts Lucide-based SVG icons into note text, properties, headers, and folder lists via inline shortcodes.
